# GSL-Lang

> A declarative graph specification language for describing directed graphs with attributes and set-based grouping. This repository contains the normative specification, reference implementation (Go), query language (GQL) extension, CLI tools, LSP server, and VS Code integration.

## Core Language

- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): Normative specification for GSL v1.0 (RFC 2119)
- [GRAMMAR.md](GRAMMAR.md): Formal grammar (EBNF)
- [GSL_GUIDE.md](GSL_GUIDE.md): Self-contained GSL language guide — syntax, semantics, gotchas
- [GO_REFERENCE.md](GO_REFERENCE.md): Go reference implementation guide — API, patterns, algorithms

## Query Language (GQL)

- [QUERY_SPEC.md](QUERY_SPEC.md): Query language specification
- [QUERY_GRAMMAR.md](QUERY_GRAMMAR.md): Query language formal grammar
- [GQL_GUIDE.md](GQL_GUIDE.md): Self-contained GQL language guide
- [QUERY_TUTORIAL.md](QUERY_TUTORIAL.md): Step-by-step GQL learning guide
- [query/testdata/README.md](query/testdata/README.md): GQL test fixture catalog (organized learning path)

## Getting Started

- [README.md](README.md): User-facing overview, quick start, and usage examples
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): Human learning journey — Getting Started, Concepts, Tutorials, Cookbook (the route for beginner users)
- [docs/getting-started/README.md](docs/getting-started/README.md): Install tools and run the two-minute test
- [docs/concepts](docs/concepts/): The graph model in plain language — nine one-concept pages (graph-model, edges, attributes, sets, structure-and-nesting, edge-dependencies, queries-and-views, parsing-and-merging, canonical-form)
- [docs/tutorials/README.md](docs/tutorials/README.md): Modelling with GSL, the flagship examples, and the GQL learning path
- [docs/tutorials/modelling-with-gsl.md](docs/tutorials/modelling-with-gsl.md): How to decide what belongs in a model — node, edge, attribute, set, nesting, edge dependency
- [docs/cookbook/README.md](docs/cookbook/README.md): Short recipes — retire a service, team views, CI rendering, release gates
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Development guide for AI agents contributing to this repo

## Implementation

- [Go reference implementation](.): Core parser, lexer, AST, graph model, serializer (Go files at repository root)
- [CLI tools](cmd/): gsl-diagram (Mermaid/PlantUML), gsl-query (query runner)
- [LSP server](lsp/): Language server protocol implementation
- [VS Code extension](editors/vscode/): Syntax highlighting and IDE support
